title: In multiple locations, there is a possible background activity launch due to a logic error in the code. (CVE-2026-58837)
description: CVE-2026-58837 is a logic error vulnerability that allows possible background activity launches in multiple code locations. This flaw can lead to local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.4.
